title: Incas Invented Freeze-Dried Food
hook: 500 years before NASA, Inca mountain farmers created freeze-dried chuño.

scenes.text: High on the Andean plateau thirteen thousand feet above sea level, intense frosts made growing standard crops nearly impossible.
scenes.imagePrompt: High-altitude windswept Andean plateau with frost-covered bunchgrass and dramatic snowy volcanic peaks on the horizon. 2D flat cartoon illustration, thick dark outlines, warm muted palette, hand-painted textures, vertical 9:16, no people in the foreground, no text, no logos
scenes.voicedText: High on the Andean plateau thirteen thousand feet above sea level, intense frosts made growing standard crops nearly impossible.

scenes.text: To guarantee food security against drought and famine, Inca farmers invented 'chuño': the world's first freeze-dried potatoes.
scenes.imagePrompt: Woven reed baskets filled with colorful native Andean purple, red, and golden potatoes arranged on stone drying terraces. 2D flat cartoon illustration, thick dark outlines, warm muted palette, hand-painted textures, vertical 9:16, no people in the foreground, no text, no logos
scenes.voicedText: To guarantee food security against drought and famine, Inca farmers invented 'chuño': the world's first freeze-dried potatoes.

scenes.text: At harvest, farmers spread thousands of small native potatoes across open straw mats during sub-zero freezing Andean nights.
scenes.imagePrompt: Starlit Andean night with frost forming crystals across potatoes spread out on golden straw mats under a full moon. 2D flat cartoon illustration, thick dark outlines, warm muted palette, hand-painted textures, vertical 9:16, no people in the foreground, no text, no logos
scenes.voicedText: At harvest, farmers spread thousands of small native potatoes across open straw mats during sub-zero freezing Andean nights.

scenes.text: At sunrise, families stomped the thawed potatoes with bare feet to squeeze out moisture, letting the blistering dry mountain sun evaporate the rest.
scenes.imagePrompt: Sunlit stone terrace showing trampled dark dried potato nuggets drying in high-altitude mountain sunshine. 2D flat cartoon illustration, thick dark outlines, warm muted palette, hand-painted textures, vertical 9:16, no people in the foreground, no text, no logos
scenes.voicedText: At sunrise, families stomped the thawed potatoes with bare feet to squeeze out moisture, letting the blistering dry mountain sun evaporate the rest.

scenes.text: Repeated for five days, the result was a rock-hard, lightweight black nugget that could be stored in royal granaries for over ten years without rotting.

scenes.voicedText: Repeated for five days, the result was a rock-hard, lightweight black nugget that could be stored in royal granaries for over ten years without rotting.

scenes.text: Soaked in water, chuño reconstituted into hearty soups that fed armies. Would you try a 500-year-old freeze-dried potato? Tell us below!
